blocks.text: We've already seen how **у** commands the genitive case to roughly mean 'by', but many more prepositions use the genitive. The four most common, including **у**, are:

items: Я хочу́ пода́рок для моего́ дру́га
I want a present for my friend
I am standing by the fence
She is sitting by the window
У твоего́ му́жа есть оди́н друг
